value.rationale: Catenary degree is an intrinsic factorization invariant of a natural infinite four-generator sequence. The law covers all n>=4, has genuine distinct residues n+3/n+4/n+5, and identifies unavoidable factorization bottlenecks rather than just evaluating examples. The 2026 full four-generator square/triangular catenary study provides directly relevant motivation for determining the same invariant in the tetrahedral companion family. Though derived from earlier presentations, a complete closed exact invariant is mathematically usable.
